Proactive mindset with a can-do attitude
Team player with a collaborative working style
Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
Proven ability to lead, mentor, and develop high-performing teams.

description.overview: As a QA/QC Specialist (Manufacturing), you will play a key role in strengthening our Quality Management operations within the Manufacturing / Assembly / Processing space.
topReasonsToJoin: Young, dynamic, and supportive working environment
Access to internal training courses and certification budget
Competitive salary reviewed twice a year
responsibilities: Optimize core quality management activities aligned with company goals and standards.
Independently manage planning and resource allocation, ensuring consistency and accuracy across all deliverables.
Take ownership of day-to-day operations related to the role and provide regular updates to relevant stakeholders.
Take ownership of quality standards and process compliance to support smooth execution and timely delivery.
Lead the execution of documentation and knowledge sharing, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and quality.
Take ownership of continuous improvement initiatives in partnership with other departments and external partners.
requirements: 3-6 years of proven experience relevant to the QA/QC Specialist (Manufacturing) role.
Solid understanding of industry best practices and relevant tools or systems.
Good command of English (written and spoken)
Adaptability in a fast-paced, changing environment
Good stakeholder management and cross-team collaboration

benefits.label: Social, health & unemployment insurance as per Labor Law
Parking allowance / shuttle bus support
Training budget and certification sponsorship
Free lunch, coffee and snacks at the office
13th month salary and performance bonus
Laptop and equipment provided
